description: A straight, low‐relief embankment approximately 230 m long and 4–6 m wide, trending NW–SE. It exhibits a paired depression on its northeast flank, consistent with a small canal or drainage ditch running parallel to the raised feature. The embankment appears as a linear bright ridge in the hillshade and curvature maps, and corresponds to a narrow band of reduced NIR reflectance (darker tone) indicating higher soil moisture or anthropogenic soil enrichment. No modern road or path is mapped at this location in OSM.

A cluster of four rectangular, gently elevated platforms (approx. 25 × 15 m each) arranged in an L-shape. These platforms are visible as discrete convex forms in the DTM hillshade, with surrounding shallow furrows that may represent small-scale canals or field boundaries. The NIR image shows a subtle darkening over each platform, suggestive of moisture‐retentive or Terra Preta soils. None of these features coincide with mapped plantations or trails in OSM.
